description: This file defines an Angular service named NoteService that manages notes through CRUD operations via HTTP requests to a backend API. It provides methods to fetch, add, update, delete, and find notes, and maintains an observable stream of notes for reactive updates.

classes.name: NoteService
classes.description: An Angular injectable service that handles CRUD operations for notes, manages notes state reactively, and interacts with backend API endpoints.

methods.name: getNotes
methods.description: Fetches notes from API and returns an Observable of notes sorted by updatedAt descending.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Loads notes from the backend and updates the internal notes observable.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Creates a new note via POST request and returns the created note.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by id via PUT request.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note identified by id via DELETE request.

methods.name: findNoteById
methods.description: Finds a note by id from the current notes stream.
